_comment: Every row here is something that was OBSERVED on a machine, not
something that was expected. §19's hardware certification is what
grows this file; a row added without a machine behind it is a
match:  vendor:device, or just vendor for a whole generation.
A device-specific row wins over a vendor-wide one.
suspend: safe | unsafe | unknown. 'unknown' is the honest default
and the Hardware Center shows it as one; a wrong 'safe' is
a lost session and looks identical to a tested machine.

quirks.note: Cirrus Logic: sin aceleración 3D utilizable; el escritorio funciona sin compositor (§4.4).
Tarjeta gráfica estándar de QEMU: es una máquina virtual, no hay suspensión real que probar.
VMware SVGA II: máquina virtual; suspensión gestionada por el anfitrión.
